title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Numbers 27: the request of the daughters of Zelophehad, the law of inheritance, and Joshua appointed to lead the congregation.

questions.text: From the families of which tribe were the daughters of Zelophehad?
questions.explanation: Zelophehad was the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph.

questions.text: Where did the daughters of Zelophehad stand to make their request?
questions.explanation: They stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the princes and all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: At the door of the Tent of Meeting
At the gate of the camp of Manasseh
On the top of Pisgah before the people

questions.text: What did the daughters say about their father's death?
questions.explanation: They said their father died in the wilderness, was not among the company of Korah, but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

answers.text: He died in the plague at Peor
He was killed in the battle against Sihon
He was swallowed by the earth with Korah
He was not in the company of Korah but died in his own sin

questions.text: What was Yahweh's answer about the daughters of Zelophehad?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "The daughters of Zelophehad speak right," and told Moses to give them an inheritance among their father's brothers.

answers.text: "Their father's name shall be taken away"
"Their land shall go to the Levites"
"They must marry within the tribe of Levi"

questions.text: If a man died with no son and no daughter, to whom was his inheritance to be given?
questions.explanation: If he had no son, it passed to his daughter; if he had no daughter, it was given to his brothers.

questions.text: What was the name of the mountain Yahweh told Moses to go up into to see the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to Moses, "Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel."

questions.text: What did Moses not want the congregation of Yahweh to be like?
questions.explanation: Moses asked Yahweh to appoint a man over the congregation, that it "may not be as sheep which have no shepherd."

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to take, describing him as a man in whom is the Spirit?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him."

questions.text: How would Eleazar the priest inquire for Joshua before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Joshua would stand before Eleazar, who would inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh.

answers.text: By the judgment of the Urim
By casting rods before the ark
By a dream in the night

questions.text: What did Moses do to Joshua before Eleazar and the congregation?
questions.explanation: Moses set Joshua before Eleazar the priest and all the congregation, laid his hands on him and commissioned him.

answers.text: He poured oil on his head before the people
He gave him his own rod to carry
He laid his hands on him and commissioned him
He put Aaron's garments on him at the Tent
